quotes.author: David Penick
quotes.text: David Penick3 months agoWe took the dolphin tour on the smaller Osprey craft with Captain Scott and Miss Amy. This tour is very well done. While they cannot guarantee you'll see the dolphins, they are very knowledgeable about where they are likely to be. Captain Scott was very informative during the tour and as you can see by the pictures, we did find the dolphins! And, bonus, we also saw several large schools of fish, a couple with sharks or other apex predators feasting among them! I would highly recommend taking this tour! 10 stars! Not just 5!

quotes.author: Kimberly Locricchio
quotes.text: Kimberly Locricchio1 year agoWe had such a great time on the Osprey Premium Dolphin Cruise with Captain Mike and Susan! They were both fantastic — friendly, knowledgeable, and full of interesting facts about the area and wildlife. The smaller boat (holds up to 15 people) made the experience feel more personal and comfortable. We saw plenty of dolphins and learned so much along the way. Highly recommend this tour for anyone looking for a more intimate and informative dolphin-watching experience.

If you are going on a boat tour I highly recommend Blue Wave Adventures. Captain Scott and first mate Cody were a blast. The boat ride itself is an adventure filled with laughter, music, and historical facts about the area. While we were not guaranteed to see dolphins. We did end up seeing them and it was awesome. I would go on this boat tour again regardless if I saw dolphins or not. P:s - If you see a piece of plastic laying on the ground today. Do the marine life a favor and pick it up. 😉

quotes.author: Christy Taylor
quotes.text: Christy Taylor5 months agoCaptain Mark, and Lexi were great. They made us feel extremely at ease, and safe with the crazy water conditions. Capt mark taught us about the area, as well as wild life. We got to see MANY MANY dolphins. We just floated right along with them! Lexi was sweet as pie, and jumped in whenever she could learn, or help out! I know she’ll be a great captain one day! We’ll definitely be back 🫶🏻

Captain Scott and Cody were AMAZING! They played great music and were very funny! We got so lucky with a beautiful day on the sea. We saw so many dolphins and they spotted them quickly! The facts about dolphins and the area was cool to learn! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this tour. Our kids absolutely loved this and had a blast! Thank you both the awesome time. We will be back on our next visit!!!
